issues.finding: Final PPO evaluation keys are drawn from the training RNG. Real training uses an initial reset split and 183 iterations; imagined training uses 150 updates. Real-vs-imagined final episodes are not paired by a common fixed key.
issues.fix: Use unpaired descriptive comparisons for historical results, or reevaluate fixed final checkpoints with fixed shared evaluation keys.

issues.finding: Posthoc heads and decoder use first 80000 frames of the same model-training dataset; head holdout uses the next 200 time rows. No different behavior-policy seed is supplied. This holdout is not held out from world-model fitting. Separate heads_audit uses eval.npz.
issues.fix: Correct appendix dataset provenance; use 25000-transition heads_audit for test metrics.

issues.finding: plan.py closed_loop plans once and executes the fixed H-step action sequence. It is not receding-horizon closed-loop goal reaching.
issues.fix: Rename historical goal test short-horizon open-loop goal reaching; distinguish reward_loop MPC.

issues.finding: Craftax behavior-policy return is mean reward from a dataset multiplied by evaluation horizon, not a matched online rollout baseline.
issues.fix: Label as dataset-rate reference or omit from matched control table.

issues.finding: 27 imagined JEPA runs are three predictor variants x three policy seeds x three encoder fits, not 27 independent model seeds; flow has one fit and nine policy runs.
issues.fix: Report per-model and per-policy endpoints, not family-level significance from pooled policy runs.

issues.finding: Real-vs-imagined controls alter heads, dynamics, data starts, rollout lengths, PPO organization and transition budget at once. Flow vs JEPA also alters reconstruction/reward supervision, architecture and history.
issues.fix: Describe complete pipeline comparison; do not causally attribute to squared loss or deterministic mean alone.

issues.finding: Flow mean8 final 150-update runs use a 60-minute cap, whereas sampled runs use 12 minutes; separate earlier 12-minute runs are retained but excluded from main comparison. Transition budgets match; wall-clock does not.
issues.fix: State same updates/imagined transitions, unequal inference compute.

issues.finding: Repository contains 12 amp4/amp16 policy runs and 24 wall/random subspace gain-4 runs. They are not needed for any accepted core conclusion and are excluded from the proposed general-model evidence set.
issues.fix: Do not present environment-specific amplification as a model improvement.

issues.finding: runs/stoch/summarize.py is an older copy; studies/stoch/summarize.py supplies current round-2 aggregation. Current saved summary equals fresh collect(), but paired.tex manually omits simulator and center reference rows generated by current code.
issues.fix: Use studies/stoch/summarize.py as canonical and new ledger for table generation.

issues.finding: Raw config records absolute checkpoint paths, generally on VMs. Local directory has only a subset of policy checkpoint binaries and no comprehensive checkpoint SHA manifest.
issues.fix: Generate remote artifact hash manifest before declaring independently reproducible checkpoint identity.

issues.finding: Existing edge reset distribution does not eliminate state-blind survival: alternating left-right policy scores 100% in all three available still-world baselines_edge files. Starts are at least 3px from the boundary and action displacement is 3px.
issues.fix: Do not use still-world edge survival to certify position feedback.
